profit_quality.assessment: The school business collects cash well because tuition and boarding fees are prepaid, but the cash is not fully distributable. The 2022-2024 operating free cash flow series was RMB384.340 million, RMB212.530 million and RMB116.477 million, with 2024 depressed by phase four construction and campus upgrades. Main ranking uses the three-year median operating free cash flow of RMB212.530 million before haircut, then applies a 0.55 cash-profit haircut for continuing campus capex, debt service, tuition-secured borrowings, VIE/PRC distribution constraints and prepaid student obligations.
adjustments: Used operating cash flow minus PPE/intangible purchases instead of reported net profit as the pre-haircut distributable cash-profit anchor.
Excluded treating government grants, fair value gains and treasury interest as core tuition earnings in the qualitative assessment.
Applied a 0.55 profit haircut rather than setting the denominator to null because the business has real recurring cash collections, but owner-level distribution is materially constrained.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2022-2024 OCF / parent net profit is approximately 1.94x, 1.65x and 1.38x respectively; capex reduced free cash flow materially in 2023 and 2024.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Strong tuition cash collection is offset by ongoing campus investment, secured debt, PRC/VIE extraction restrictions and the need to keep prepaid tuition cash inside the school operation.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Reported operating cash flow supports profit, but part of the cash comes from advance tuition and must fund future teaching services.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Annual report does not split maintenance and growth capex; 2024 capex was RMB192.5 million and related to phase four construction plus maintenance/upgrades.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Working capital is structurally favourable because students pay in advance, but contract liabilities of RMB512.885 million create service/refund obligations.
